title: Non-Compliance Letters under 505B(d)(1) of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act
summary: Section 505B(d)(1) requires FDA to send a PREA Non-Compliance letter to sponsors who have failed to submit their pediatric assessments required under PREA by the final due date, have failed to seek or obtain a deferral or deferral extension.
